'''Counselors''' were a group of eleven [[Carosite]]s who advised the elected [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] leader on [[Carosi XII]]. The eleven counselors were chosen from the eleven most prominent Carosi families.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
